symptom: `alter page … replace <grid> column(Balance) with { column (Attribute: Balance, ShowContentAs: customContent) { dynamictext … ContentParams: ({1} = Balance) } }` on a Data grid 2 whose data source is a MICROFLOW or NANOFLOW: check and exec clean, then mxbuild fails with "An attribute is required when column sorting is enabled" (and CE0402 "No value specified" on the cell's dynamic text). The same statement on a database-sourced grid builds. `insert after <grid> column(X) { column … }` has the same defect. mendixlabs/mxcli#1468.
cause: The two DataGrid2 column paths in cmd_alter_page.go (applyInsertWidgetMutator, applyReplaceWidgetMutator) took the column entity context from mutator.EnclosingEntityForChildren, a pure BSON walk. A flow source stores no entity in the page (it is the flow's RETURN type), so the context was "", resolveAttributePath left `Balance` unqualified, and BuildDataGrid2Column writes an AttributeRef only for a path with two dots — the column was written with no attribute and sorting on.
fix: Both column paths call alterEntityContext(ctx, mutator, grid, true, …), which falls back to EnclosingDataSourceFlow + resolveDataSourceFlowEntity — the resolution every other ALTER PAGE insert/replace (FINDINGS #55) and the check-time pass already used. Test: cmd_alter_page_flow_column_1468_test.go; bug test mdl-examples/bug-tests/1468-….mdl.
insight: #55 fixed flow-source entity resolution by adding a helper (alterEntityContext) and routing the general widget path through it, but the column special-cases above it kept calling the raw BSON accessor. When a resolution helper exists, grep for direct calls to the primitive it wraps (here EnclosingEntityForChildren) — each one is a call site the fix did not reach. The reporter's 'correlation, not cause' (flow vs database source) was exactly the cause; a two-grid repro, one per source kind, settles it in one `mx check`. The dropped attribute is silent at write time because the serializer quietly emits AttributeRef=nil for an unqualified path rather than refusing it.
